name: Kusakabe Tsubaki
source:
A selfish and spoiled younger sister that has romantic feelings for her brother. She is part of the track & field team.

[spoiler]She is blackmailed by Tatsuya into having sex with unknown men while being blindfolded.[/spoiler]
